x: In the Youth's 5Km at Lambeth Richard Dorman placed 6th in 25:49 with T.McDermot and P.Morris also competing. Diane Cook was third home in the Women's 10Km and Jane Pritchard was in action in the intermediate girls 5Km.
Richard Dorman was well up the field in the Youths 5,000 metres, placing 6th in 24:33 with 23rd T.McDermot in 27:00 and 31st P.Morris 27:44.
They are obviously showing the benefits of the guidance and training of Ray Middleton. Junior 3Km. 1.T.McDermot 14:45.

Fortunately the few who raced all did themselves credit - particularly John Newnham and Peter Morris. 1.D.Rowland (Steyning) 78:32; 3.J.Newnham 79:12; 11.V.Hutchins 83:01; 22.P.Morris 86:44; 26.K.McDermot 89:43; 27.T.McDermot 89:50.
